Position Overview:
Duke Kunshan University is a world-class liberal arts university offering high-quality, interdisciplinary undergraduate and graduate programs. The IT Applications team within the Office of Information Technology works closely with customers and peer teams to deliver a wide range of applications and services.

This position is for a Data Engineer, a key technical role within the IT Applications team. You will be responsible for building and evolving the core data platform for Duke Kunshan University. Your work will be instrumental in enabling university-wide, data-driven decision-making by transforming our diverse data ecosystem into a scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytical foundation. We are looking for a technical expert who not only excels in engineering but also collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure our data assets deliver maximum impact.

Reports to:
Manager – IT Applications

Essential Duties:
1.	Collaborate with customers, business analysts and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into effective data architecture and pipeline solutions.
2.	Design, build, and manage robust, scalable data ingestion and integration pipelines to consolidate data from diverse source systems into a central data platform for data processing and automation.
3.	Design and implement scalable data models for the enterprise data platform to transform and structure raw data into reliable, well-documented datasets that serve for analytics and data products.
4.	Develop and maintain core components of the data platform including data service APIs, a unified data asset catalog, and standardized data layers to empower self-service analytics and data product consumption.
5.	Collaborate with business teams to define key metrics and success criteria for data products and take ownership of developing the corresponding dashboards and visualizations to translate data into actionable insights.
6.	Contribute to the data governance framework by collaborating with Data Owners to implement data quality standards, monitoring, and remediation, and to ensure data assets are properly classified, documented, and accessible.
7.	Ensure the operational excellence, stability, and performance of the data platform through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting complex issues, and systematic optimization of queries and pipelines.
8.	Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for data architectures, pipeline specifications, data dictionaries, and operational procedures.
9.	Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in data engineering, cloud platforms, and big data ecosystems to drive continuous innovation.
10.	Work toward achieving assigned annual objectives and KPIs, demonstrating accountability for performance and results.
11.	Perform other duties as assigned.
12.	University employees' job responsibilities will continue to expand in scope and depth as the University grows in size and complexity in its programs.

Required Qualifications:
1.	Full-time bachelor’s degree or above in information technology, computer science, or a related field preferred.
2.	At least 5 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related field.
3.	Strong ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.
4.	Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills in both English and Chinese.
5.	Strong motivation and capacity to learn new concepts and apply emerging technologies to transform business and technical processes and drive continuous improvement.
6.	A strong interest in, coupled with a practical understanding of, the complete data product lifecycle—from data curation and development to enabling consumption and measuring business impact.
7.	A strong sense of ownership for the stability, performance, and data quality of the systems you build.
8.	Experience in building data ingestion pipelines, pulling data from diverse sources, and orchestrating the subsequent ETL/ELT processes to deliver clean, reliable data for downstream consumption.
9.	Practical experience with Python for data processing, automation, and scripting. Familiarity with Java or Scala is a plus.
10.	High proficiency in SQL and extensive hands-on experience with at least one major RDBMS (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle).
11.	Practical, hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms and services (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks). 
12.	Solid understanding and practical experience in data modeling for analytical systems (e.g., Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Data Vault).
13.	Solid understanding of data governance principles and hands-on experience with supporting tools for metadata management, data lineage, or data quality.
14.	Partner with stakeholders to define data product and related metrics and develop the corresponding tracking dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Preferred Qualifications
1.	Hands-on experience in implementing a data platform end-to-end. Direct experience within a higher education setting is a strong plus.
2.	Hands-on experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark) and streaming data technologies (e.g., Apache Kafka, Flink).
3.	Experience productizing administrative data and metrics via APIs (e.g., RESTful, GraphQL).
4.	Expertise in enterprise data warehouse design, including dimensional modeling, layered architecture, and metric system planning.
5.	Experience in designing and supporting data analysis solutions for AI/ML and LLM initiatives.
6.	Practical experience with enterprise systems (e.g., ERP like Oracle, SAP) in a complex organizational environment.
7.	Experience in building data solutions for core administrative domains (e.g., Finance, HR), with an understanding of the key data entities, lifecycle, and quality requirements specific to these functions.

How to Apply:
Please be advised the salary is commensurate with experience.
Please submit your formal application by searching the position on DKU recruitment portal.
